mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every locked demand in a public hard graph has a one-demand graph operation changing its base from e to e' and exposing an actual output in K(e') minus K(e), while preserving the same colouring size and the rainbow-C7 property.
would_close: actual external carrier for every locked demand
mechanisms.kill_test: Test every natural b-to-w edge replacement in the smallest n=15 expansion; kill universality if each nonempty switch creates a non-rainbow C7.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Any collection of individually legal one-demand switches with distinct owners can be performed simultaneously and its output rank equals the number of switches.
mechanisms.kill_test: Seek two switches sharing a C7 witness or one output; kill if distinct owners coexist with output matching rank one or simultaneous illegality.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A power-large graph-realizable catalogue of local switch witnesses always projects to a power-large set of distinct external missing B-edge outputs.
mechanisms.kill_test: The n=15 expansion has 736 length-four/five path witnesses over one output; kill every bound stated before output-fibre control.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Applying DRC after output projection gives, for every deficient cut T, at least |T| distinct legal external outputs adjacent to T in every public hard branch.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the locked four-demand cut and smallest expansions; kill if the projected output set has size below the cut deficiency despite large witness common neighbourhoods.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every actual absorber hypergraph derived from a public hard graph has maximum output/resource codegree o(Delta) once duplicate certificates are identified.
mechanisms.kill_test: Parallel graph paths and identical-base switch candidates test whether output codegree can equal degree.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Under a proved maximum codegree bound, a semi-random nibble followed by deterministic cleanup reduces every demand cut deficiency to zero using compatible external absorbers.
mechanisms.kill_test: Demand an explicit all-cut potential and cleanup; kill any argument proving only expected matched size or substituting dummy outputs.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Compatible graph-realizable absorber certificates form a matroid parity system on actual missing B-edge outputs, and each uncovered demand increases its rank by one.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test augmentation on four owned switches sharing one output and on the locked n=14 graph; kill if the proposed common-ground exchange cannot name a new B-edge.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The vertex-capacitated C7 switch network has min-cut at least the locked-circuit deficiency in every public hard graph.
mechanisms.kill_test: In the n=15 expansion delete every transition failing the exact rainbow-C7 switch test and compute whether any path reaches the sole external output.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After deleting o(n) exceptional vertices, the typical core retains all but o(D) of the external absorber output rank for every deficient demand cut.
mechanisms.kill_test: Put the sole external edge of the smallest expansion through exceptional vertex w; kill rank preservation when typical witness abundance remains but external rank vanishes.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every contracted locked core of deficiency delta has at least delta distinct graph-legal exceptional links, with bounded overlap across cores.
would_close: one external link per locked deficit
mechanisms.kill_test: Contract the n=14 locked class and inspect its minimal n=15 expansion; kill any link counted solely from paths or from a switch that makes a non-rainbow C7.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: If each output missing B-edge and each internal switch resource belongs to at most C absorber certificates, then catalogue size at least C times the total residual demand count forces a compatible saturating absorber matching.
mechanisms.kill_test: Build exact finite hypergraphs with both separate output and shared hidden-resource collisions; kill if the stated local bound omits a resource needed for compatibility.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A legal external switch for one member of each inclusion-minimal deficient cut suffices, by iteration, to saturate the entire typed carrier graph.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test whether the chosen switch can destroy legality or output availability for another cut; require Hall expansion after every iteration.
